samples.text: The morning coffee negotiated hard, but eventually agreed to help.
I put my keys somewhere safe, which was a bold move against myself.
After the rain stopped, the street looked freshly edited.
The bakery smell made my detour feel like responsible planning.
My calendar has jokes; it put Monday right after Sunday again.
I meant to send a short message and produced a tiny novel.
At the market, the tomatoes looked more organized than my week.
The train was late, so everyone became an expert in phone inspection.
I cleaned my desk and found a pen from an earlier version of my life.
The evening wind made the whole city sound a little calmer.

samples.text: 早上的咖啡像个严肃的教练，终于把我叫醒了。

雨刚停，街道像重新打开的一页纸。
菜市场的番茄看起来比我更有周末计划。
日历很有幽默感，又把星期一安排在星期天后面。
我只想写一条短消息，结果写成了一封小论文。
面包刚出炉，回家的路突然变得很短。
整理桌面时，我发现一支比计划还长寿的笔。
地铁稍微晚点，大家就开始认真研究手机屏幕。
夜里的茶壶很安静，但好像什么都明白。

samples.text: 朝のコーヒーは少し渋ったけれど、最後には助けてくれました。

短いメッセージを書くつもりが、小さな物語になりました。
